title: Counting Constrained Binary Strings
problem: How many length-n binary strings avoid two consecutive 1s? Find a rule that works for every n, counting the empty string at n = 0. Derive and justify a general formula or recurrence for the count, including the necessary initial values. Check the result on small n. Do not assume a particular proof method.

strategies.title: State recurrence and check
strategies.approach: Count strings by length and by whether the last bit is 0 or 1. Derive transitions from the no-adjacent-ones rule, combine the states into a recurrence, and verify the first values by direct enumeration before proving the recurrence by induction.
